data.name: Reveal Strike
data.detailed_description:
Reveal Strike abandons the traditional "What You See Is What You Get" shooter logic, introducing unprecedented "Dynamic Vision Warfare." The center of the battlefield begins as a total void. You master a unique "Dual-Ammo System"—using reveal rounds to unmask the map and lethal firepower to terminate enemies.

【Core Gameplay】

This is not a game for mindless run-and-gun tactics. Your magazine is loaded with two distinct types of ammunition:

  • 👁️ Reveal Rounds: Upon impacting a hidden area, sonar pulse technology briefly "renders" the terrain and cover within the impact radius.

  • 💥 Lethal Rounds: Standard ammunition used to eliminate hostiles.

You must make life-or-death decisions at every moment: Do you spend Reveal Rounds to gain intel? Or do you rely on your memory of the map to lay down blind suppressive fire?

【Game Features】

🕵️ Original "Hidden Realm" Mechanic Break free from the reliance on vision found in traditional shooters. Players must rely on spatial memory to mentally reconstruct the full picture of the battlefield.

🎮 UE5 Ultimate Graphics Powered by Unreal Engine 5’s Lumen Global Illumination and Nanite Virtualized Geometry, experience seamless visual transitions from the invisible void to fully rendered reality.

🤝 5v5 Deep Tactical Cooperation Lone wolves won't survive here. Squads require precise role division: Who handles "Lighting" (Recon)? Who provides fire superiority? Who takes the flank? Communication and coordination are the only keys to victory.

⚡ Dynamic Interactive Power-ups Is the match in a stalemate? Scavenge for interactive items scattered in the corners of the map! Securing these grants special tactical advantages—from increased movement speed and expanded reveal ranges to temporary invisibility or full-map outlines. Fighting for these objectives can instantly turn the tide of battle.

【Custom Maps】

Not satisfied with the official battlefields? We provide a map editor based on UE5, allowing the game to load map data exported directly from the editor.

  • 🏗️ Build Freely: Utilize in-game assets to hand-craft your own tactical arena.

  • 📏 Define Rules: You customize the logic—decide which zones are permanently invisible and which remain visible.

  • 🌐 Community Sharing: Upload your masterpieces to the Creative Workshop.

data.short_description: Reveal Strike is a third-person team-based shooter. Here, visibility is fleeting, and danger is ever-shifting. The core zones of the map are shrouded in the "Hidden Realm" by default. You face not only the barrels of enemy guns but the sheer terror of the unknown.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
